requirements.title: IEEE_CLASS returns the named class value for supported classes
requirements.definition: IEEE_CLASS returns the named IEEE_CLASS_TYPE value for NaN, infinity, subnormal, negative normal, negative zero, positive zero, positive normal, and otherwise IEEE_OTHER_VALUE according to the support and value class described by the source.

pending.ieee-class-nan-results: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(0.0); supported branch classifies IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_QUIET_NAN) as IEEE_QUIET_NAN and IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN) as IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.ieee-class-infinity-results: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(0.0); supported branch classifies IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_NEGATIVE_INF) and IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_POSITIVE_INF) as the matching infinity class constants; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.ieee-class-subnormal-results: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_SUBNORMAL(0.0), and RADIX(0.0)==2; supported branch forms positive s=TINY(0.0)*0.5 and negative ns=IEEE_COPY_SIGN(s,-1.0), pre-verifies IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(ns), and asserts the matching subnormal class constants; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.ieee-class-finite-and-zero-results: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0); supported branch constructs nz=IEEE_COPY_SIGN(0.0,-1.0), pre-verifies IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(nz), classifies -1.0, nz, 0.0, and 1.0 as IEEE_NEGATIVE_NORMAL, IEEE_NEGATIVE_ZERO, IEEE_POSITIVE_ZERO, and IEEE_POSITIVE_NORMAL, and observes the zero signs with IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE rather than equality; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.ieee-class-other-value-result: No portable oracle can force a conforming processor to produce a value outside the supported NaN, infinity, subnormal, zero, and normal classes while satisfying the IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE guard and IEEE_CLASS invocation restriction. Future fixtures must not manufacture processor-specific other values.
